subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw V1 permanently expose `api.registerReadinessCriterion` and `gateway.readiness` as supported public Plugin SDK and operator configuration contracts?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API plus an upgrade-sensitive configuration surface, and the repository policy requires maintainer product judgment before adding such permanent compatibility commitments.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the plugin registration API and operator selectors, then require final-head fresh-install and upgrade proof plus a passing SDK baseline before merge.

options.title: Land core readiness only
options.body: Defer plugin registration and external criterion identifiers until maintainers define the permanent SDK contract separately.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Keep the existing Gateway readiness model and direct deployment-specific checks to external automation until a narrower use case is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the plugin registration API and operator selectors, then require final-head fresh-install and upgrade proof plus a passing SDK baseline before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository-level product owner for a new core/Plugin SDK compatibility commitment; specific subsystem CODEOWNERS were not available.
